title: Flipping an Image
summary: Given an n x n binary matrix, reverse each row, then change each 0 to 1 and each 1 to 0, and return the modified matrix.
statement: Given an n x n binary matrix, reverse each row, then change each 0 to 1 and each 1 to 0, and return the modified matrix.
constraints: image is a rectangular binary matrix.
Reverse each row horizontally, then invert every bit.
reference_solution:
def flip_and_invert_image(image):
    return [[value^1 for value in reversed(row)] for row in image]
hints: Flip and invert act independently on each output position.
Traverse each row in reverse order and toggle with XOR one.
Return [[value^1 for value in reversed(row)] for row in image].
Reversed iteration supplies the horizontal mirror and XOR maps binary zero/one exactly to its complement.
editorial: Reversed iteration supplies the horizontal mirror and XOR maps binary zero/one exactly to its complement.

tests.explanation: Reversing rows and toggling bits produces [[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[1,1,1]].
Each row is independently reversed and inverted.
